description: Inspect a route owned by the calling agent: its status, provider attempts and payment exposure. Use it after route_work or continue_route reserves a route; to preview without creating anything use plan_work, and to follow an MCP task use get_route_task. Requires a registered-agent API key with agent:read; limited to 60 calls per minute per agent. Routes owned by other agents return not found. Free.

route_id.description: UUID of a route you own, from route_work, continue_route or get_route_task

name: get_route
title: Inspect route
